enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Close eyes. Remain lying on the bed. Turn over occasionally. Remain asleep under the blanket. Breathe steadily. Remain lying until the alarm sounds.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on the bed. Swing legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Reach for the light switch. Press the light switch on. Turn on the tap. Cup hands under the water. Splash water on the face. Pick up the toothbrush. Hold the toothbrush under the tap. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Put the toothpaste tube down. Brush teeth. Spit into the sink. Rinse mouth with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the hook. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Press the kitchen light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out bread and eggs. Place them on the counter. Close the refrigerator door. Open the cabinet. Take out a plate. Place the plate on the counter. Open the cabinet. Take out a mug. Place the mug on the counter. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Pick up the toaster plug. Insert the plug into the socket. Press the toaster lever down. Pick up the egg. Crack the egg into the pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Turn the induction cooker dial to set heat. Stir the egg with a spatula. Turn off the induction cooker. Pick up the spatula. Slide the egg onto the plate. Pick up the toasted bread. Place the bread on the plate. Pick up the kettle. Pour hot water into the mug. Add coffee powder to the mug. Stir the coffee with a spoon. Sit down on the chair at the table. Pick up the fork. Cut the egg with the fork. Lift food to mouth. Chew and swallow. Pick up the mug. Sip the coffee. Put the mug down. Continue eating. Finish the meal. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink. Place them in the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plate and mug. Turn off the tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes, checking phone and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a work shirt. Take out trousers. Lay the clothes on the bed. Take off the sleepwear. Put on the work shirt. Button the shirt. Put on the trousers. Zip up the trousers. Close the wardrobe door. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Press the phone power button. Look at the phone screen. Swipe the phone screen. Put the phone down on the bed. Pick up the work bag. Open the bag zipper. Place the phone inside the bag. Place a badge inside the bag. Place a water bottle inside the bag. Close the bag zipper. Pick up the bag. Slip the bag onto the shoulder. Walk out of the bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the work shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the house. Close the front door. Lock the front door with the key. Put the key into the bag. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Look at the phone. Board the bus. Tap the transit card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Hold the handrail. Stand on the bus. Look out the window. Pull the stop request cord. Get off the bus. Walk along the sidewalk. Cross the street at the crosswalk. Walk toward the hospital entrance. Push the hospital door open. Enter the hospital building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the locker room. Open the locker door. Take out the work uniform. Put on the work uniform. Close the locker door. Walk to the nurses station. Pick up the patient chart. Read the patient chart. Walk to the patient room. Knock on the door. Push the patient room door open. Greet the patient. Pick up the blood pressure cuff. Wrap the cuff around the patient arm. Press the start button on the monitor. Read the monitor display. Remove the cuff. Record the reading on the chart. Pick up the thermometer. Place the thermometer near the patient forehead. Press the button. Read the temperature. Place the thermometer down. Pick up the medication cup. Hand the cup to the patient. Pick up the water cup. Hand the water cup to the patient. Pick up the phone handset. Dial the doctor extension. Speak into the handset. Hang up the handset. Walk to the supply cabinet. Open the cabinet door. Take out gauze and gloves. Close the cabinet door. Carry the supplies to the patient room. Put on the gloves. Wipe the wound with gauze. Place used gauze in the waste bin. Remove the gloves. Wash hands at the sink. Turn off the tap. Dry hands with paper towel. Type notes on the computer keyboard. Click the mouse. Save the record. Walk back to the nurses station. Pick up the phone. Answer the call. Write down the message on paper. Walk to the next patient room.

Take off the work uniform. Place the uniform in the locker. Close the locker door. Pick up the work bag. Walk out of the locker room. Push the hospital door open. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Board the bus. Tap the transit card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit down on the seat. Look at the phone. Pull the stop request cord. Stand up. Get off the bus. Walk along the sidewalk. Cross the street at the crosswalk. Walk to the house. Take the key out of the bag. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the front door open. Walk inside. Close the front door. Lock the front door.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing dinner with the induction cooker and eating
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Press the kitchen light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out vegetables and meat. Place them on the counter. Close the refrigerator door. Open the cabinet. Take out a pot. Place the pot on the counter. Turn on the tap. Rinse the vegetables under the water. Turn off the tap. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables. Place the cut vegetables into the pot. Place the pot on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Press the induction cooker heat button. Pick up the spoon. Stir the pot with the spoon. Place the lid on the pot. Open the cabinet. Take out a bowl. Place the bowl on the counter. Pick up the pot lid. Place the lid down. Pick up the spoon. Scoop the food into the bowl. Press the induction cooker power button off. Pick up the bowl. Carry the bowl to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the chopsticks. Lift food to mouth. Chew and swallow. Continue eating. Finish the meal. Stand up. Carry the bowl to the sink. Place the bowl in the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the bowl. Turn off the tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and freshening up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Press the bathroom light switch on. Press the water heater switch on. Take off the clothes. Place the clothes in the laundry basket. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the water temperature. Stand under the shower. Wet the hair with water. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the hand. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair with water. Pick up the body wash. Squeeze body wash onto the loofah. Rub the loofah on the body. Rinse the body with water. Turn off the shower tap. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair with the towel. Dry the body with the towel. Hang the towel on the hook. Put on the clean clothes. Press the bathroom light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk into the living room. Press the living room light switch on. Pick up the TV remote control. Press the TV power button. Aim the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Place the remote on the sofa arm. Sit down on the sofa. Lean back against the sofa. Pick up the remote control. Press the volume button. Place the remote down. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the phone. Swipe the phone screen. Place the phone on the sofa. Pick up the remote control. Press the channel button. Place the remote down. Cross legs on the sofa. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the remote control. Press the TV power button off. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to catch up on personal matters and messages
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the desk. Pull the chair out. Sit down on the chair. Press the computer power button. Wait for the computer to start. Place hands on the keyboard. Type the login password. Press the enter key. Move the mouse. Click the browser icon. Scroll the web page with the mouse wheel. Open the message application. Click the unread message. Type a reply on the keyboard. Press the enter key to send. Click the next message. Type a reply. Press the enter key to send. Open the email page. Click the unread email. Read the email. Click the reply button. Type the email reply. Click the send button. Click the calendar icon. Check the schedule. Close the browser window. Click the shut down option. Press the computer power button off. Stand up. Push the chair back to the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a light snack and hot drink
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Press the kitchen light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out a yogurt cup. Place the yogurt on the counter. Close the refrigerator door. Open the cabinet. Take out a small bowl. Place the bowl on the counter. Pick up the spoon. Scoop the yogurt into the bowl. Place the spoon in the bowl. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Open the cabinet. Take out a mug. Place the mug on the counter. Place a tea bag in the mug. Pick up the kettle. Pour hot water into the mug. Place the kettle on its base. Pick up the bowl. Carry the bowl to the table. Place the bowl on the table. Pick up the mug. Carry the mug to the table. Place the mug on the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the spoon. Lift the yogurt to mouth. Eat the yogurt. Pick up the mug. Sip the hot drink. Place the mug down. Finish the snack. Stand up. Carry the bowl and mug to the sink. Place them in the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the bowl and mug. Turn off the tap. Press the kitchen light switch off.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV in bed and winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Press the bedroom light switch on. Pick up the TV remote control from the nightstand. Press the TV power button. Aim the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Place the remote on the nightstand. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Place the head on the pillow. Pick up the remote control. Press the volume button. Place the remote on the nightstand. Watch the TV screen. Turn the body to the side. Pick up the remote control. Press the TV power button off. Place the remote on the nightstand. Press the bedroom light switch off. Lie on the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine, brushing teeth and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Get off the bed. Walk to the bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Press the bathroom light switch on. Turn on the tap. Cup hands under the water. Splash water on the face. Pick up the toothbrush. Hold the toothbrush under the tap. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Put the toothpaste tube down. Brush teeth. Spit into the sink. Rinse mouth with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Place the toothbrush in the holder. Press the light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk into the bedroom. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Place the head on the pillow. Close eyes. Remain lying on the bed. Turn over to the side. Remain asleep under the blanket. Breathe steadily.
